integrity: The finite-m probability product and leading macroscopic survival limit were established in arXiv:2602.16135v1. The contribution is an explicit first-order uniform asymptotic correction, derived here from that exact product. Numerical tests are corroboration rather than the proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement takes the number of bracketed variables to infinity first, then chain size to infinity. The uniform O(m^-2) term has an unspecified absolute constant; no simultaneous n,m limit and no global finite-m monotonicity are proved.
title: Uniform first finite-chain correction for Catalan Gödel-implication truth values
